title: Summit Elite Travel Benefits Chart
content:
Each tier of the Crestline Summit Loyalty Program carries a set of travel benefits on the member's own tickets and credits.

| Tier | Checked bags included per direction, any fare brand | Preferred seats free at booking | Main Plus extra-legroom seats free at booking | Same-day confirmed change fee waived | Flight-credit extension, reinstatement and telephone redemption fees waived |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Summit Member | 0 | No | No | No | No |
| Summit Silver | 1 | Yes | No | No | No |
| Summit Gold | 2 | Yes | Yes | Yes | No |
| Summit Platinum | 2 | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| Summit Diamond | 3 | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| Summit Chairman | 3 | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes |

**Reading the chart**

- The bag column counts bags per direction for the member only.
- Extra-legroom Main Plus seating and the same-day change waiver begin at Summit Gold; the credit service fee waiver begins at Summit Platinum.
- Hypothetical reading: on a round trip, a Summit Diamond member has 3 bags included in each direction.
